source.note: provider.ts changed after 01 (sidekick request path, Fusion lead guidance). The OAuth-only check still runs first in the shared infer path for lead and sidekick requests; tests/pi-auth-storage.test.ts passes in the full offline run.

decision: User decisions (2026-10-19): add Fusion as a separate Pi-native scope; pairing = selected Devin model as lead + SWE-2 Medium sidekick; synchronous handoff; shared OAuth and budget; budget raised by environment variable up to 100.

fusion.modelIds: fusion:<group id without the family: prefix>; one per publishable family: group whose models support tool calls, only when uid:swe-2-medium is a supported exact UID. Fixture: 65 fusion models (391 total = 65 groups + 261 exact + 65 fusion).
fusion.projection: Same thinkingLevelMap, context window, output limit, input modalities and cache configs as the lead group; name 'Fusion · <group> + SWE-2 Medium · 비용 미상'; devin.fusion = { leadID, sidekickID }. Requests resolve to the lead group's exact UID for the selected level. Cache restore re-derives fusion models from the restored projection.
fusion.activation: Tool `sidekick` registered with defaultActive=false. model_select and session_start activate it only for fusion models found in the provider's own list and remove it otherwise; other active tools are preserved. A `--tools` allowlist must include `sidekick`.
fusion.leadGuidance: Provider appends FUSION_LEAD_GUIDANCE to the system prompt of fusion lead requests only (custom system prompts keep it). Sidekick requests do not receive it.

sidekick.tool: { message: string } -> text report; details { sidekickModel, steps, toolCalls, isResumed }; executionMode sequential
sidekick.loop: Synchronous inside the lead's tool call. Model request via provider.streamSidekick(); tool calls run only through ctx.executeTool() (Pi validation, hooks, permissions; recorded as nestedCalls). `sidekick` is removed from the sidekick's tool list.
sidekick.auth: modelRegistry.getApiKeyAndHeaders(sidekick model) -> OAuth toAuth; provider OAuth-only check applies.
sidekick.conversation: Own sessionId/cascadeId/trajectoryId per Pi session, new executionId per handoff, own step counter; lead step, recovery and auxiliary flags are not consumed (lifecycle.acquire isSidekick).
sidekick.context: Kept in memory per Pi session (max 8 sessions); a failed handoff is rolled back; reset on session_shutdown and not restored after resume/reload.

fusion.budget: Lead and sidekick share the user run budget (default 8). PI_DEVIN_MAX_MODEL_CALLS accepts integers 1-100; invalid values stop extension load. Index.ts passes it to the provider lifecycle.

checks.observed: 391 unique models incl. 65 fusion entries mirroring lead groups with sidekick uid:swe-2-medium; no fusion entries without swe-2-medium

3/3 pass: fusion model activates sidekick (and keeps fixture_add); lead swe-2-high -> sidekick swe-2-medium x2 -> lead; separate sidekick cascade/trajectory/clientSession/executionId; lead steps 0,1 and sidekick steps 0,1; sidekick tools exclude sidekick; lead prompt carries Fusion guidance after a custom system prompt, sidekick prompt does not; nestedCalls [fixture_add ok]; all metadata.apiKey = OAuth session; execution used 4; failed handoff returns a tool error and is absent from the next handoff's history while earlier context persists; switching to the family model deactivates sidekick; budget 3 stops after lead 1 + sidekick 2 with no further requests
sidekick lease shares budget without consuming lead step/recovery; PI_DEVIN_MAX_MODEL_CALLS 40 reaches lifecycle via index.ts, unset keeps 8, invalid values throw

ok: 63/63 byte-identical, 0 semantic/shape diffs, 18 runtime cases; no wire change

limitations: Not CLI Fusion: no fusion-* router pairs, AssignModel pricing/JWT, background sidekick, mid-handoff brief injection or asynchronous report injection.
Sidekick context is in memory only; it resets after resume/reload or a new session and is not compacted, so very long sidekick histories can hit the context window.

Sidekick requests call the provider directly: Pi before/after provider request hooks are not applied to them, and the per-request deadline is the Pi 1.3 default 300000ms rather than a session-specific timeout.
Only mock services were used. Real Devin behavior of the paired flow is unverified; 07 may run it only with a SWE-2 lead Fusion model after separate approval.
